title: Dynamic Top-Boundary Solver-Interface Adapter & HeadCalc Provider Bridge
purpose: Qualify the solver-facing interface seam required to consume the already-qualified F-SI29 restricted dynamic B1.10 top-boundary evaluator inside the existing HeadCalc residual/Jacobian trajectory without introducing a second hydraulic authority.

allow: extend the generic top-boundary provider result contract so one evaluation can express flux or prescribed-head regime explicitly
carry trial-local surface face conductivity, candidate ponding, evaporation, runoff depth and net surface flux required by the existing residual/mass checks
adapt the exact F-SI29 evaluator behind that generic provider contract
make HeadCalc consume the generic provider result without calling F-SI29-specific APIs
preserve the fixed-flux provider as the simple flux-only implementation
add executable equivalence, mass, retry-independent and deterministic qualification gates
forbid: changing F-SI29 physical equations or thresholds
changing bottom-boundary physics or F-SI28 tangent equations
routing production SoilWater(2) through the typed solver service
persisting top-boundary trial outputs as committed solver state
broadening nonlinear runoff, macropore, frost, swdra2 or time-dependent pondmx scope

required_semantics: provider evaluation is a pure trial evaluation from explicit/current trial inputs plus request-local immutable provider context
result explicitly distinguishes flux and prescribed-head regimes
head regime provides the exact surface-face conductivity used by residual and Jacobian
candidate ponding and runoff remain trial-local until outer transaction acceptance
surface water balance can be evaluated without reading hidden legacy precipitation/evaporation globals when the dynamic provider is active
unsupported/invalid provider results fail closed and do not silently fall back to a different surface physics route
fixed-flux provider behavior remains unchanged in its admitted scope
HeadCalc remains the single nonlinear Richards trajectory and does not gain F-SI29-specific science
qualification_gates: generic-adapter output identity with direct F-SI29 over the frozen 9072-case oracle matrix
flux/head/ponded-head/linear-runoff routes all represented through the generic contract
provider request/context immutability and interleaved worker-style replay
HeadCalc explicit-provider route exercises both flux and head regimes with hard mass-balance closure
F-SI28 prescribed-qbot tangent path remains available and no additional nonlinear trajectory/Jacobian is introduced

downstream_handoff.rule: Only after F-SI30 qualification may production SoilWater(2) construct the dynamic provider context, invoke the typed solver service and materialize its accepted output capsule.
